name: Question 3
problem: Find the differential $\text{d}f$ for the function $f(x,y,z)=\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2}+y+{z}^{3}).$
worked_solution:
We compute the differential using the formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{d}f(x,y,z) & =(\frac{∂f}{∂x})\,\text{d}x+(\frac{∂f}{∂y})\,\text{d}y+(\frac{∂f}{∂z})\,\text{d}z \\  & =\frac{2x\,\text{d}x}{{x}^{2}+y+{z}^{3}}+\frac{\text{d}y}{{x}^{2}+y+{z}^{3}}+\frac{3{z}^{2}\,\text{d}z}{{x}^{2}+y+{z}^{3}}\end{aligned}
$$

Question 3
?

Find the differential df for the function f(x,y,z)=ln⁡(x2+y+z3).

a
 dxx2+y+z3+dyx2+y+z3+dzx2+y+z3
b
 dx2x+dy+3z2dz3z2
c
 2xdxx2+y+z3+dyx2+y+z3+3z2dzx2+y+z3
d
 2xdxx2+y+z3+2ydyx2+y+z3+2zdzx2+y+z3
e
 dx2x+dyy+3z2dz3z2
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We compute the differential using the formula:

df(x,y,z)=(∂f∂x)dx+(∂f∂y)dy+(∂f∂z)dz=2xdxx2+y+z3+dyx2+y+z3+3z2dzx2+y+z3
